scripts.build:android: bun run prebuild:plugin && expo prebuild --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86_64
scripts.build:ios: bun run prebuild:plugin && expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -quiet -workspace ios/CallKitTel.xcworkspace -scheme CallKitTel -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/build ARCHS=arm64 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && test -d ios/build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/CallKitTel.app && echo '✓ iOS build succeeded: ios/build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/CallKitTel.app'
